currentParagraphText: “A human, eh? Are you here alone, or will you be bringing any companions?” he asked in a super casual voice, which surprised Jake a bit.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: That is when Jake realized... he hadn’t even made his mask visible. During these days with Artemis, he naturally didn’t walk around with a mask on all day but had made it invisible. He’d entirely forgotten to make it show again, and he guessed that was why the beastkin hadn’t recognized him.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The beastkin, who looked to have descended from some kind of rodent, observed Jake and was the first to speak.
